reviews.title: Not worth it

Not worth it when there are free options and the app offers nothing unique. Also constant annoying popups to connect your data to it, presumably so they can sell it.

reviews.title: I paid for this app a while ago and now it has restricted access to the plan
reviews.text: I have already paid for this app. Now it is littered with full screen ads for its subscription, and only has a week available. I have no interest in giving you more money if you are not honoring the people who have already paid for this service.

reviews.title: NOT FREE
reviews.text: Might as well run on your own it starts off free then get into paying just to run

reviews.title: I have to buy this now???
reviews.text: DO NOT BUY!!! The positive reviews on this app are because for years it was free. Now they want to charge you $30/month for a pre-set timer. I used to love this app, I used it to get myself up to a 5k then a 10k and I continued using it any time I took a break from running and needed a slow transition back in. That said, IT IS NOT WORTH ANY MONEY! The couch to 5k program has been around much longer than this app, you do not need to pay for pre-set timers. There are other apps out there that are still free. I have Just Run Zero to 5k now. It’s literally the same thing. Or you could just google the program and set timers yourself. Don’t let greedy companies suddenly start charging you for something that is free all over the internet. They say they “made the difficult decision” lol “for then best for their users” lol…they did it because they think their users are stupid.

reviews.title: Bait and Switch
reviews.text: I used this app years ago to help get into running shape. Now that I’m back to running, I figured I’d use an app that helped in the past only to find after 4 runs it’s a paid subscription. You aren’t doing this with the best interests of your users in mind. You’re doing this for your own gain. I don’t understand why you can’t offer a bare bones free model while giving people who want to pay more features. It’s a greedy cash grab disguised as a helpful free tool.

reviews.title: A rip off
reviews.text: They don’t give you anything worthwhile for free. The meat and potatoes of this are paywalled to an absurdly pricy subscription.

reviews.title: Not free
reviews.text: App is fine. Will take you through one week before the subscription is required.

reviews.title: Lame that you have to pay
reviews.text: I used this app years ago when the whole program was free. I'm getting back into running after a lengthy illness and I'm annoyed to see that you have to pay to finish the program last W2D1. I found another app and uninstalled this one.

reviews.title: Pay Wall smh
reviews.text: Of course just going along with the state of this greedy world. This app used to offer all weeks for free and really helped my running. Recommended it to a friend to find out that it only goes to week 2 then have to pay beyond that. There’s noone left who does things to genuinely help people. Everything is for a profit. Extremely disappointed and will NOT be recommending this app.

reviews.title: Program is now behind paywall
reviews.text: Used this app in the past and it was great. Disappointing to see that you must now pay after the first week.

reviews.title: Paywall entire program?
reviews.text:
I used C25K many years ago now, and while the program is great, returning to find they’ve changed their subscription model to restrict access to the entire program after day 4 is a laugh. Making one pay for advanced stats and access to their extra features made sense, but $30 for 3 months on… a 2 month program where the base thing you’re blocking is just a timer to tell me when to run versus when to walk? The payment model already clearly banks on you forgetting about this charge. I’d be happy to one time purchase this to support zenlab, but the monthly model seems scummy.

I’ll be trying out one of the free alternatives that look more streamlined, which is too bad because I did like this app, but not nearly enough for such a high paywall for the most basic feature I actually use it for!
